Nivedita Prabhu is a junior honors students from Colorado who is double majoring in biochemistry and political science with help from her faculty advisor John Koh and graduate student Michael Phillip. Prabhu’s unusual combination fits her interest in both medicine and politics and sets her up to pursue her longterm goal of earning an MD/MPH degree. Because of the flexibility of the political science degree, she is able to handle the requirements of the biochemical degree.
